parameters.content:
## PR review flow (starting point)

Polling design: n8n cannot receive GitHub webhooks from the public internet at `n8n.localhost`, so this workflow **polls** open PRs on a schedule instead.

Flow: Schedule -> List open PRs -> Get PR diff -> Prepare request -> **Review** -> Post review comment.

**Swap point:** the *Review* node. It calls OpenRouter with the review rubric today. To hand review to a human, replace it with your notification/approval step (Slack, email, or a GitHub review request) and keep the same output contract.

Set OWNER/REPO below, attach credentials (GitHub + OpenRouter), and pick a model matching `.opencode/models.json` (reviewer).

assignments.name: body
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-6-luna', messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are an independent, read-only PR reviewer. Review the diff against this checklist: correctness and intent; tests and evidence; docs updated in the same commit; scope and contracts; simplicity and anti-slop (no dead code, unused deps, speculative abstraction); harness changes (flag AGENTS.md, .opencode/**, .claude/**, .github/**, scripts/*, pom.xml, CLAUDE.md); boundaries (no credentials). Cite path:line; separate verified from inference. Do not approve or merge. Output: first line VERDICT: approve | request-changes | comment; then CHECKLIST: item=pass|fail|n-a; then FINDINGS: - [severity] path:line - problem / fix.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Diff: ' + $json.data } ] }) }}

parameters.content:
## SWAP POINT
Replace this node with a human step (Slack/email/GitHub review request) that returns the same VERDICT/CHECKLIST/FINDINGS contract. Nothing downstream changes.
